title: Repeated Returned Payments on a Home Purchase Agreement: Stepped Returned-Payment Fee
content:
**Clause 9.3 — Repeated returns.** The returned-payment fee on a Home Purchase Agreement steps up when returns repeat on the agreement. The returns counted are the returned payments the agreement's ledger shows in the twelve months up to the date the fee is charged, the one being charged included.

(a) Where three or more returns are counted, the fee is the collection's returned-payment fee multiplied by the number of returns counted.

(b) Where exactly two returns are counted, the fee is the collection's returned-payment fee plus a flat 25.00.

(c) Otherwise the fee is not stepped up.

The collection's returned-payment fee is 35.00 in every collection (Pathway, Meadow, Heritage, Crestview, Summit and Reserve).

**Schedule to Clause 9.3.**

| Returns counted in the twelve months, the one being charged included | Stepped fee |
|---|---|
| 1 | Not stepped up |
| 2 | 35.00 plus 25.00, which is 60.00 |
| 3 | 35.00 multiplied by 3, which is 105.00 |
| 4 | 35.00 multiplied by 4, which is 140.00 |
| 5 | 35.00 multiplied by 5, which is 175.00 |

**Notes.**

1. The twelve-month window runs back from the date the fee is charged; a return older than twelve months before that date is not counted.
2. The count is of returned payments on this agreement's own ledger.
3. *Hypothetical cases.* A fee is charged on 10 October for a return. Where the agreement ledger also shows earlier returns on 15 March and on 20 November of the year before, all three fall within the twelve months up to 10 October, so three are counted and the fee is 105.00. Where the earlier returns are on 15 March and on 20 August of the year before, the August return is more than twelve months before the fee date, so two are counted and the fee is 60.00.
